questions.question: 30% of a number is 21 more than 15% of 120. What is the number?
questions.questionHtml: 30% of a number is 21 more than 15% of 120. What is the number?
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

15% of 120 = 18

Given: 30% of Number = 18 + 21 = 39

If 30% → 39, then 10% → 13

So, 100% → 130

∴ The correct answer is 130.

Alternate Method

Given:

15% of 120 = (15 ÷ 100) × 120 = 18

Let the unknown number be 'x'.

⇒ 30% of x = 15% of 120 + 21

⇒ 0.30 × x = 18 + 21

⇒ 0.30x = 39

⇒ x = 39 ÷ 0.30

⇒ x = 3900 ÷ 30

⇒ x = 130

∴ The correct answer is 130.

Additional Information

Percentage Change

To find a value after a percentage increase: Final Value = Initial Value × (1 + r/100).

Base Change Rule

If A is x% more than B, then B is [x/(100+x)] × 100% less than A.

Fraction Equivalents

Always remember common fractions: 15% = 3/20 and 30% = 3/10 for faster calculation.

questions.question: The present population of a village is 28000. If it increases at the rate of 5% per annum, population after 2 years will be:
questions.questionHtml: The present population of a village is 28000. If it increases at the rate of 5% per annum, population after 2 years will be:
questions.solution:
Given:

Present population of village = 28000

Rate at which population increases = 5%

Time period = 2 years

Formula used:

\({P_n} = P{\left( {1 + \frac{R}{{100}}} \right)^n}\)

Where, Pn = Population after n years

P = Present population

R = Rate of growth of population

n = time period (in years)

Calculations:

Population after 2 years,

\( \Rightarrow {P_2} = 28000{\left( {1 + \frac{5}{{100}}} \right)^2}\)

\( \Rightarrow {P_2} = 28000{\left( {\frac{{21}}{{20}}} \right)^2}\)

\( \Rightarrow {P_2} = 28000\left( {\frac{{441}}{{400}}} \right)\)

⇒ P2 = 70 × 441

⇒ P2 = 30870

∴ The population after 2 years will be 30870

questions.question: A salesman is allowed 12% commission on the total sales made by him and a bonus of 1% on sales over Rs. 15000. If the total earning of salesman is Rs. 7650. Find total sales.
questions.questionHtml: A salesman is allowed 12% commission on the total sales made by him and a bonus of 1% on sales over Rs. 15000. If the total earning of salesman is Rs. 7650. Find total sales.
questions.solution:
Given:

A salesman is allowed 12% commission on the total sales made by him and a

bonus of 1% on sales over Rs. 15000.

Total earning of salesman = Rs.7650

Calculation:

If he had given an extra 1% on the sales of Rs. 15000 also then his total

commission will be

⇒ Total commission = 7650 + 1% of 15000 = Rs. 7800

It is given that 13% of sales = Total commission of salesman

∴ Total sales = 7800 / 13 × 100 = Rs. 60,000

questions.question: If 85% of (x - y) = 35% of (x + y), Then y is what percentage of x?
questions.questionHtml: If 85% of (x - y) = 35% of (x + y), Then y is what percentage of x?
questions.solution:
85% of (x - y) = 35% of (x + y)

⇒ 0.85x - 0.85y = 0.35x + 0.35y ⇒ 0.5x = 1.2y ⇒ y/x = 5 / 12 

Calculate the percentage: 5/12 × 100% = 125/3% = 41\(2\over 3\)%

questions.question: In an examination Mohit got 30% of the maximum marks but failed by 25 marks. Another student who scored 38% got 15 marks more than the pass marks. The necessary pass percentage required is:
questions.questionHtml: In an examination Mohit got 30% of the maximum marks but failed by 25 marks. Another student who scored 38% got 15 marks more than the pass marks. The necessary pass percentage required is:
questions.solution:
30% + 25 = 38% – 15 ⇒ (38% – 30%) = (15 + 25) ⇒ 8% = 40

⇒ 1% = 5 marks, 5% = 25 marks 

The necessary pass percentage required = (30% + 5%) ⇒ 35%

questions.question: Two years ago, the population of a town was 66000. The population increased by 5% in the first year and decreased by 5% in the second year. Find the present population of the town.
questions.questionHtml: Two years ago, the population of a town was 66000. The population increased by 5% in the first year and decreased by 5% in the second year. Find the present population of the town.
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

When a value increases by x% and then decreases by x%, the net change is always a decrease of x2/100%.

Here, x = 5%, so net decrease = 52 / 100 = 25 / 100 = 0.25%.

Total decrease in population = 0.25% of 66000 = (0.25 / 100) × 66000 = 165.

Present population = 66000 − 165 = 65835.

∴ The correct answer is 65835.

Alternate Method

Given:

Initial population (2 years ago) = 66000

First year increase (R1) = 5%

Second year decrease (R2) = 5%

Formula Used:

Present Population = Initial Population × (1 + R1/100) × (1 − R2/100)

Calculations:

⇒ Present Population = 66000 × (1 + 5/100) × (1 − 5/100)

⇒ Present Population = 66000 × (105/100) × (95/100)

⇒ Present Population = 66000 × (21/20) × (19/20)

⇒ Present Population = (66000 / 400) × 21 × 19

⇒ Present Population = 165 × 399

⇒ Present Population = 165 × (400 − 1)

⇒ Present Population = 66000 − 165

⇒ Present Population = 65835

∴ The correct answer is 65835.

Additional Information

Successive Percentage Change

If a value changes by a% and then by b%, the effective percentage change is given by the formula: [a + b + (ab/100)]%.

Constant Percentage Increase and Decrease

When a quantity is increased by x% and then decreased by the same x%, there is always a net decrease equal to (x/10)2% or x2/100%.

Population Growth Formula

If the population grows at a constant rate R% per annum, the population after n years is Pn = P(1 + R/100)n. For a decrease, use (1 − R/100).

questions.question: The population of a city is 5000. The number of males are increased by 23% and the number of females are increased by 20%. The population thus increased to 6090. Find the number of males initially in the city.
questions.questionHtml: The population of a city is 5000. The number of males are increased by 23% and the number of females are increased by 20%. The population thus increased to 6090. Find the number of males initially in the city.
questions.solution:
Given:

Total population = 5000

The number of males are increased by 23% and the number of females are increased by 20%.

New population = 6090

Calculation:

The number of males are increased by 23% and the number of females are increased by 20%

If the number of males and females together have a 20% increase and males have an additional 3% increase.

20% increase on population will lead to the population of 6000.

But the population has increased to 6090.

So, the additional 90 is 3% of males.

100% of males = 3000

∴  The total number of males initially was 3000.

questions.question: Amina saves 16% of her income. Now her income is increased by 20% but she still saves the same amount as before. What is the percentage increase in her expenditure?
questions.questionHtml: Amina saves 16% of her income. Now her income is increased by 20% but she still saves the same amount as before. What is the percentage increase in her expenditure?
questions.solution:
Solution :

Given data :

% saving = 16%

% increase in income = 20%

Concept used :

Income = Expenditure + Savings

Increament of x% =(100 + x)/100

% increment = (final quantity – initial quantity)/(initial quantity) × 100

Calculation :

Let us assume Total income (I1) of amina is 100 unit.

⇒ Savings (S1) = 100 × 16/100

⇒ 16 unit

⇒ Expenditure (E1) = 100 – 16

⇒ 84 unit

Increased Income (I2) = 100 × (100 + 20)/100

⇒ 120 unit

Savings (S2) = S1

⇒ S2 = 16 unit

⇒ Expenditure (E2) = 120 – 16

⇒ 104 unit

⇒ Increased expenditure % = (E2 – E1)/E1 × 100

⇒ (104 – 84)/84 × 100

⇒ 20/84 × 100

⇒ 23.8%

 

∴ Amina’s expenditure will increase by 23.8%.

 

Alternate method :

⇒ Increased expenditure % = (20/84) × 100

⇒ 23.8%

 

∴ Amina’s expenditure will increase by 23.8%.

questions.question: In an examination of 180 marks of a subject, 75% marks are allocated for theory and the rest for project work. Veena scored 60% in theory. What percentage of marks must she score in the project to achieve an overall 62% marks in the subject?
questions.questionHtml: In an examination of 180 marks of a subject, 75% marks are allocated for theory and the rest for project work. Veena scored 60% in theory. What percentage of marks must she score in the project to achieve an overall 62% marks in the subject?
questions.solution:
Given:

In an examination of 180 marks of a subject, 75% marks are allocated for theory and the rest for project work.

Veena scored 60% in theory.

Calculations:

Total marks needed = 62% of 180

⇒ (62/100) × 180 = 111.6

Total theory marks = 75% of 180 = 135

Total practice marks = 25% of 180 = 45

Marks he got in theory = 60% of 135 = 81

Required extra marks to get 62% = 111.6 - 81 = 30.6

Now, 30.6 as percentage of 45 marks 

⇒ (30.6/45)100 = 68%

∴ The correct choice is option 2.
